arguments.title: Secondary-page deadline and Wes’s June 21 example
arguments.body:
## Secondary-page deadline
If the primary is still handling an incident and the cause has not been isolated, engage the secondary before the 45-minute boundary. The test is when the primary sends the page, not when the secondary acknowledges it. For example, a page sent at minute 44 meets the timing rule even if acknowledged at minute 47; record acknowledgment latency separately. Do not wait until minute 45 to page.

## Wes’s June 21 example
During his first solo on-call shift overnight June 21, Wes handled a minor metrics-router cardinality blip. At minute 40, while unsure, he brought in the secondary; together they resolved it, and no escalation was needed. This is a good example of seeking secondary support before the deadline without treating the page itself as an escalation or ownership transfer.
